<?php

use Ratchet\MessageComponentInterface;
use Ratchet\ConnectionInterface;
use React\EventLoop\Loop;
use React\Promise\Deferred;

class SessionStore {
    private array $sessions = [];
    private array $defaults = [
        'role' => 'guest',
        'permissions' => ['read'],
        'rateLimit' => 100,
        'theme' => 'default'
    ];

    public function createSession(string $connId): array {
        $this->sessions[$connId] = $this->defaults;
        return $this->sessions[$connId];
    }

    public function getSession(string $connId): ?array {
        return $this->sessions[$connId] ?? null;
    }

    public function &getDefaults(): array {
        return $this->defaults;
    }

    public function updateSession(string $connId, array $patch): array {
        if (!isset($this->sessions[$connId])) {
            $this->sessions[$connId] = $this->defaults;
        }
        $this->sessions[$connId] = $this->deepMerge($this->sessions[$connId], $patch);
        return $this->sessions[$connId];
    }

    private function deepMerge(array $target, array $source): array {
        foreach ($source as $key => $value) {
            if (is_array($value) && isset($target[$key]) && is_array($target[$key])) {
                $target[$key] = $this->deepMerge($target[$key], $value);
            } else {
                $target[$key] = $value;
            }
        }
        return $target;
    }
}

class ConfigResolver {
    private SessionStore $store;
    private array $protectedKeys = ['role', 'permissions'];

    public function __construct(SessionStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
    }

    public function resolveUpdate(string $connId, array $payload): array {
        $sanitized = $this->sanitizePayload($payload);
        return $this->store->updateSession($connId, $sanitized);
    }

    private function sanitizePayload(array $payload): array {
        $clean = [];
        foreach ($payload as $key => $value) {
            if (in_array($key, $this->protectedKeys, true)) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($key === '__defaults__') {
                continue;
            }
            $clean[$key] = $value;
        }
        return $clean;
    }
}

class WebSocketServer implements MessageComponentInterface {
    private SessionStore $sessionStore;
    private ConfigResolver $configResolver;
    private array $pendingOps = [];

    public function __construct() {
        $this->sessionStore = new SessionStore();
        $this->configResolver = new ConfigResolver($this->sessionStore);
    }

    public function onOpen(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $connId = spl_object_hash($conn);
        $this->sessionStore->createSession($connId);
        $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'connected', 'session' => $connId]));
    }

    public function onMessage(ConnectionInterface $from, $msg) {
        $connId = spl_object_hash($from);
        $data = json_decode($msg, true);

        if (!is_array($data) || !isset($data['action'])) {
            $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid message format']));
            return;
        }

        match($data['action']) {
            'update_preferences' => $this->handlePreferenceUpdate($from, $connId, $data),
            'batch_configure' => $this->handleBatchConfigure($from, $connId, $data),
            'get_session' => $this->handleGetSession($from, $connId),
            default => $from->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Unknown action']))
        };
    }

    private function handlePreferenceUpdate(ConnectionInterface $conn, string $connId, array $data): void {
        if (!isset($data['preferences']) || !is_array($data['preferences'])) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Missing preferences']));
            return;
        }

        $result = $this->configResolver->resolveUpdate($connId, $data['preferences']);
        $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'updated', 'session' => $result]));
    }

    private function handleBatchConfigure(ConnectionInterface $conn, string $connId, array $data): void {
        if (!isset($data['operations']) || !is_array($data['operations'])) {
            $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Missing operations']));
            return;
        }

        $deferred = new Deferred();
        $this->pendingOps[$connId] = $deferred;

        Loop::addTimer(0.01, function() use ($conn, $connId, $data, $deferred) {
            $results = [];
            foreach ($data['operations'] as $op) {
                if (!is_array($op)) continue;
                
                if (isset($op['inherit']) && $op['inherit'] === true) {
                    $defaults = &$this->sessionStore->getDefaults();
                    if (isset($op['patch']) && is_array($op['patch'])) {
                        foreach ($op['patch'] as $k => $v) {
                            $defaults[$k] = $v;
                        }
                    }
                    $results[] = ['inherited' => true];
                } else {
                    $results[] = $this->configResolver->resolveUpdate($connId, $op);
                }
            }

            unset($this->pendingOps[$connId]);
            $deferred->resolve($results);
            $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'batch_result', 'results' => $results]));
        });
    }

    private function handleGetSession(ConnectionInterface $conn, string $connId): void {
        $session = $this->sessionStore->getSession($connId);
        $conn->send(json_encode(['type' => 'session', 'data' => $session]));
    }

    public function onClose(ConnectionInterface $conn) {
        $connId = spl_object_hash($conn);
        if (isset($this->pendingOps[$connId])) {
            $this->pendingOps[$connId]->reject(new \Exception('Connection closed'));
            unset($this->pendingOps[$connId]);
        }
    }

    public function onError(ConnectionInterface $conn, \Exception $e) {
        $conn->send(json_encode(['error' => 'Internal error']));
        $conn->close();
    }
}
